benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Lifetime Free option from AU Small Finance Bank suited for travel & miles users with 8 domestic lounge visits/yr.
highlights: Up to 48 days of interest-free credit period
Option to choose the billing cycle as per business requirements
Lifetime free credit card with no joining and annual fees
milestone_benefits: Designed primarily for business expenses and may not suit personal spending requirements
get_this_card_if: You are looking for a business credit card to manage business purchases and operational expenses
You frequently make GST, tax, utility, or procurement-related payments
You want better visibility and tracking of business expenses
You travel within India occasionally and can benefit from complimentary domestic lounge access

faqs.q: What can I use AU Purchase Credit Card for?
faqs.a: The card can be used for a wide range of business expenses, including GST and tax payments, utility bill payments, procurement, and other operational or capital expenditures.

faqs.q: What is the interest-free period on AU Purchase Credit Card?
faqs.a: AU Purchase Credit Card offers an interest-free period of up to 48 days on eligible transactions, depending on the billing cycle and payment due date.

faqs.q: Does AU Purchase Credit Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.a: Yes. The Visa variant of the card offers 8 complimentary domestic airport lounge visits in a year, subject to a maximum of 2 visits per calendar quarter.

faqs.q: Can I choose the billing cycle for AU Purchase Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes. The card offers the flexibility to choose a billing cycle based on your business requirements, helping you align payments with your cash flow.

practical_community_warnings: High 3.5% (+GST) forex markup makes international swipes net negative.
Quarterly spend thresholds for domestic airport lounge access
Exclusion of rent, wallet, utilities, education, and government spends from reward points

Check spend criteria and pre-generate terminal QR access via official portals (LoungeOne.ai / TFS / HOI) before arriving at the airport.
